keyFindings.description: B1. probedWindowId -> rewriteIssueWindowId now fires for a LIVE window whose recorded panes merely lack identity (every legacy locator on the deployed daemon): the legacy root's resync-tick resurrect, or a plain spawn_worker on a live legacy tree, opens a fresh window and repoints the live legacy workers' (and on the spawn_worker path the live legacy root's) tmuxWindowId to it while their panes stay in the old window. The old window is then in no locator; listUnknownOwnedWindows lists it and after TMUX_RECONCILIATION_GRACE_MS (120 s) reconcileTmuxWindows runs kill-window on processes the daemon still counts as live. Reproduced with processes.test.ts's own manager() fixture (throwaway, not committed): impl locator after resurrect {tmuxWindowId:'@43', tmuxPaneId:'%3'}; kills [['tmux','-L','legion-omp','kill-window','-t','@42']]; same for spawnWorker(root, root, 'tester') (root locator -> @43/%0, kill-window @42). Invariant to restore: a window still holding a pane of a claim the daemon treats as live stays in knownWindows. Options: (a) stop rewriting persisted locators' window ids and let probedWindowId return the first recorded window in which any pane verifies; (b) repoint only locators whose verdict proves the pane is not theirs (pane-gone/pid-mismatch/start-mismatch), never no-identity. Regression test required.

B2. closeTreeLocked (1147-1151) derives skipGraceful from probe(), and probe reports a no-identity locator dead without touching tmux; so closeTree on a live legacy root sends no shutdown frame over its own role-scoped socket, the kill gate refuses on no-identity, the locator is deleted and the tree marked closed while the root keeps running with a revoked capability until the sweep kill-windows it (no session_shutdown, no /process/exit). Pre-change the probe found the pane alive and the close was graceful. Deterministic for every tree already lingering at upgrade (the resync probe visits only active trees) and reachable for any active tree closed before its first resync tick. Fix: skip the graceful branch only on a pane-gone verdict (e.g. skipGraceful: !verdict.verified && verdict.reason === 'pane-gone'); the socket path is identity-independent and is exactly what controllerAlive now uses. Regression test: closeTree on a legacy live root sends the shutdown frame.

Non-blocking: stopProcess runs the graceful branch before the identity gate, and the stale-locator guards feeding retireWorkerLocator (markWorkerDeadLocked 810, retireUnconfirmedBoot 995, closeTreeLocked's delete guard 1201) compare tmuxPaneId alone. Pre-existing and low-probability (same-token relaunch reissued the same %N racing a socket-close retire), but every locator now carries panePid/paneStartTicks; compare those in the guards.
